entities.name: Transport of user data via control plane procedure
entities.description: Procedure to transfer user data via the control plane in an encapsulated form between the UE and the MME.

entities.name: EMM-CONNECTED mode
entities.description: EMM state where the UE has an established NAS signaling connection.

entities.name: EMM-IDLE mode
entities.description: EMM state where the UE does not have an established NAS signaling connection.

entities.name: CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message
entities.description: NAS message used by the UE to request establishment of a control plane service.

entities.name: ESM DATA TRANSPORT message
entities.description: ESM message used to transport user data via the control plane.

entities.name: UE-initiated in EMM-CONNECTED mode
entities.description: Condition where the UE initiates the procedure while in EMM-CONNECTED mode.

entities.name: Network-initiated in EMM-CONNECTED mode
entities.description: Condition where the network initiates the procedure while the UE is in EMM-CONNECTED mode.

entities.name: UE-initiated in EMM-IDLE mode
entities.description: Condition where the UE initiates the procedure in EMM-IDLE mode by including ESM DATA TRANSPORT in CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST.

relations.description: Procedure can be initiated by the UE when in EMM-CONNECTED mode.
Procedure can be initiated by the network when the UE is in EMM-CONNECTED mode.
Procedure can be initiated by the UE in EMM-IDLE mode using CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST with ESM DATA TRANSPORT.
UE includes ESM DATA TRANSPORT message in CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST when initiating procedure in EMM-IDLE mode.
CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message contains ESM DATA TRANSPORT message as an information element.
UE-initiated procedure in EMM-CONNECTED mode requires the UE to be in EMM-CONNECTED state.
Network-initiated procedure requires the UE to be in EMM-CONNECTED state.
UE-initiated procedure in EMM-IDLE mode requires the UE to be in EMM-IDLE state.
